name: How do you make an ADU bathroom feel bigger?

mainEntity.name: What design choices make a small ADU bathroom look and feel less cramped?
mainEntity.text: What design choices make a small ADU bathroom look and feel less cramped?

acceptedAnswer.text: A small ADU bathroom can feel much larger when the design reduces visual clutter and keeps the layout open. Light-colored finishes, a glass shower enclosure, large-format tile, and strong layered lighting all help the room feel less boxed in. A wall-mounted or compact vanity can free up floor area, and a mirror placed to reflect natural or task lighting can make the room feel brighter and deeper. Keeping the plumbing concentrated on one wall can also reduce odd bumps or boxed-in chases that make the room feel smaller. In many ADUs, the biggest mistake is trying to fit too many design features into a tiny bathroom. Simpler is usually better. If the bathroom is part of a luxury design, the materials can still feel upscale without using heavy patterns or dark surfaces that shrink the space visually. The goal is to make the room feel intentional, not crowded.
acceptedAnswer.description: A small ADU bathroom feels bigger when it uses light colors, a glass shower enclosure, compact fixtures, large-format tile, and good lighting. Keeping the layout open and limiting visual breaks also helps. A well-placed mirror and a clean wet wall can make the room feel more spacious without changing the footprint.
